sections.text: Come along to Toynbee Hall for an activity-filled three day event to test our new outdoor space.
This Thursday-Saturday we will be holding an open event packed with free activities to find out what we should include in a new community garden.

As part of the redevelopment of Toynbee Hall, we’re building a community garden with in front of our newly restored historic building. We want to know how to make this a space that everyone can enjoy.
We will have chess, table tennis, gardening, play equipment, a display of plans for the public garden and much more as we look to inform our decision on what to include in the new green space.
Please pop along on your lunch break, one afternoon, Saturday morning or whenever suits to help us create a garden that is welcoming to everyone.
Come along from: 9am – 4:30pm on Thursday and Friday 10am – 4pm Saturday
